The '''ice-beetles''' were a creature found on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. Their [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] bite could cause their victim to become encased in a tomb of ice. The only way to combat the ice-beetle's bite was the juice of the [[fire plant]] found exclusively on the [[Mountain of Doom]].

[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] was once bitten by an ice-beetle.
